user.title: Veolia Water
user.description: Sign in to your Veolia / Sorea customer portal.

data_description.portal_url: Override the portal base URL. Leave as default for Veolia Catalonia.
data_description.contract_number: Restrict to a specific contract. Leave empty to use whichever the portal returns.

error.unsupported_portal: This portal is not supported. Only the Spanish and Catalan Veolia portals work (sorea.veolia.cat, agbar.veolia.cat, hidraqua.veolia.es...), not French ones such as eau.veolia.fr or mel-ileo.fr.
error.cdn_blocked: The portal's CDN returned a block (HTTP 403/429). Try again later.

data_description.portal_site: Liferay site name in the portal URL, e.g. `soreaonline` in /group/soreaonline/inicio. Leave empty to detect it automatically.
